text:
maya: quick(ish) proposal — rebalance per-GPU max_tokens_per_batch after the profiling sweep. saw some surprising packing loss on T4/A10 for long seqs; H100/A100 still green.

liam: can you drop the numbers?

maya: pasted sample from yesterday's run (50k requests spread across models + seq mix). note: all runs use kernel-selection v2.3 and kv-cache compaction OFF.
```
GPU   p50(ms)  p95(ms)  p99(ms)  avg_tokens_per_batch  packing_efficiency
T4    42       130      240      48                   0.62
A10   38       110      210      52                   0.59
L4    30        90      150      64                   0.73
A100  24        70      120      96                   0.88
H100  20        55      100     110                   0.92
```

maya: interpretation — on T4/A10 we hit kernel-selection fallback frequently because sequence lengths > kernel threshold trigger a different matmul path. that path cares more about continuous KV locality; with our current max_tokens_per_batch the KV cache gets fragmented across many small-ish batches so we lose packing_efficiency.

sasha: hmm. so even though avg_tokens_per_batch is lower on T4/A10, latency p99 is worse because we get vectorized kernel miss + higher context swap overhead?

maya: exact. also kernel-selector picks a slower kernel when per-batch token variance > 40% (roughly). small batches with some long tails blow up.

anil: what about lowering max_tokens_per_batch for T4/A10 but raising max_batch_size? put long requests into a slow-lane that tolerates higher GPU occupancy but lower kernel-switch churn.

maya: proposed policy (config snippet):
```yaml
policies:
  - gpu: T4
    max_tokens_per_batch: 64   # down from 128
    max_batch_size: 48        # up from 32
    queue_policy: fifo_slo

  - gpu: A10
    max_tokens_per_batch: 80
    max_batch_size: 56
    queue_policy: fifo_slo

  - gpu: L4
    max_tokens_per_batch: 96
    max_batch_size: 64
    queue_policy: balanced

  - gpu: A100
    max_tokens_per_batch: 192
    max_batch_size: 96
    queue_policy: packed_priority

  - gpu: H100
    max_tokens_per_batch: 256
    max_batch_size: 128
    queue_policy: packed_priority
```

liam: sounds reasonable. what's the expected perf/regression risk window?

maya: medium. risks: (1) short-request tail latency might slightly increase on A100/H100 if we overpack and cause kernel-switch heat, (2) KV cache compaction will need a small tweak to avoid evicting prefixes for long sessions.

sasha: can we add a quick kernel-selection metric to the console? a counter for kernel_switches per-minute per-GPU plus fraction of batches that triggered fallback. would make rolling back faster.

maya: yes — I'll open a small dashboard PR. basic query: `sum by(gpu, kernel) (rate(kernel_switch_total[5m])) / sum(rate(batch_started_total[5m]))`

infra-bot: deploy-check: staging job 7321 started for branch batch-token-scaling. estimated runtime 18m.

anil: suggested experiment plan:
- run A/B for 24h: 20% of traffic -> new policy on T4/A10 only
- collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, packing_efficiency, kernel_switch_rate, kv_compaction_rate, per-token cost
- autoscale watch: ensure we don't hit quota at peak

liam: add perf-regression gate: if p99 increases >5% AND packing_efficiency decreases >4% rollback automatically.

maya: ack. I'll ship the canary tomorrow AM, and add the dashboard. will also toggle kv-cache compaction param to aggressive for the canary to reduce fragmentation — lower eviction threshold from 0.2 -> 0.15.

sasha: one more ask — add an endpoint-level override so long-session APIs (chat with persistent context) can opt into `slow_lane: true`. avoids penalizing short completion APIs.

maya: good call. will add opt-in header `x-rw-slow-lane: 1` and also a server-side rule to auto-classify sessions with >4 turns as slow.

liam: :thumbsup: please tag me on the PRs.

maya: will do. thanks all. :eyes:
